purpose: Close the first remaining active-target Edge gap: one fresh synthetic receiver-to-Edge-to-Hub durable forwarding receipt on supported Apple-silicon macOS, using an isolated Hub-owned handoff and a fresh reachable target.

scope.preferred_target: existing macos13-arm64 target; no new VM
deferred: named-source TeslaMate parity and passive provenance

isolated_topology_proposal.edge_hub_delivery: 192.168.64.10:21443; exact non-loopback private guest address observed in the Hub-owned target preflight
isolated_topology_proposal.hub_fixture: A fresh Hub-owned process on the same target at 127.0.0.1:18488; this endpoint was observed free in the target preflight and any change requires a new exact endpoint in the handoff before launch.
isolated_topology_proposal.forbidden_reuse: Do not attach to, alter, or reuse any retained pre-existing Hub process, root, credentials, invitation or session; use only the fresh exact endpoint and inputs in a newly authorized handoff.

target_binding.target_role: supported Apple-silicon Mac only; no new VM
target_binding.exact_private_address: 192.168.64.10; wildcard 0.0.0.0 and loopback 127.0.0.1 remain forbidden for the Edge Hub-delivery bind by the config validator.
target_binding.preflight_receipt: Hub target preflight verified macos13-arm64, macOS 13.7.4, arm64, guest UID 501/admin, private address 192.168.64.10, and free 127.0.0.1:8080, 192.168.64.10:21443, 127.0.0.1:21444 and 127.0.0.1:18488 bindings. No Edge process, LaunchAgent, file, PKI input or listener was created.

fresh_runtime_root.preparation_receipt: Hub created the root only after an absent-before-create check; root and children are non-symlinked 0700 directories. No files have been created. The retained /Users/Shared/TeslatlasEdge root remains untouched and ineligible for this run.

edge_candidate_boundary.artifact_rule: This preparation binds the existing current-source Apple-silicon candidate by its recorded hashes; no build or package installation is authorized in this handoff. A later runtime receipt must reverify the candidate bytes before staging.

artifacts.verification: Recorded candidate build used Rust 1.98.0 and the pinned Go 1.27.0 bridge; package, Edge Mach-O and receiver Mach-O hashes were rechecked before this preparation.

dispatcher_binding.source: Fixed by the pinned Teslatlas dispatcher patch; it is not a receiver JSON key.

fresh_config_binding.root_selection: EdgeConfig accepts these separate canonical absolute paths through --config. The shipped macOS helper and LaunchAgents intentionally remain fixed to /Users/Shared/TeslatlasEdge; they must not be loaded for this fresh-root preparation. No source fix is required for the direct CLI binding.

edge_candidate_boundary.empty_root_rule: Use a genuinely fresh disposable state root, or obtain an explicit owner-approved disposal receipt for the retained prior macOS subset root. Do not delete or overwrite an occupied root.

exact_submission_binding.status: fresh values bound only by private Hub handoff; producer submission remains unauthorized

private_identity_handoff.binding: A separately versioned owner-only identity binding is supplied by Hub in the runtime handoff after this proposal is frozen; this proposal intentionally carries no private identity path or digest.
private_identity_handoff.contents: Hub-owned private identity and transaction binding; values are not echoed or duplicated in this descriptor

producer.source_sha256: Hub must supply the exact fresh producer source/manifest SHA-256; the Edge receiver binary hash is not a producer-helper identity
producer.helper_binary_sha256: Hub must supply the exact fresh darwin-arm64 synthetic producer helper SHA-256; no helper is present in the Edge package candidate

receiver_server_pki.server_leaf_sha256: Hub must supply the exact fresh owner-only receiver server leaf SHA-256

receiver_client_pki.accepted_identity_profile: The pinned receiver verifier must accept the exact leaf/profile; wrong issuer, missing identity metadata or mismatched SAN/key is a pre-submit failure.

required_hub_handoff.retained_root_preservation: /Users/Shared/TeslatlasEdge remains untouched; no package helper or LaunchAgent may bind it to this preparation.
required_hub_handoff.candidate_confirmation: Confirm the recorded darwin-arm64 package, Edge binary and receiver binary hashes before staging; no build is authorized by this preparation.
required_hub_handoff.consumer_inputs: Owner-only paths for the Edge server CA, Hub client certificate/key and delivery bearer, with distinct regular files, modes and hashes recorded without exposing values; invoke the Edge-owned preparer with the explicit expected server IP 192.168.64.10 and reject wildcard, loopback or other IP SANs.
required_hub_handoff.authorization: Hub may stage the fresh root, PKI/config, init/doctor, and a bounded empty receiver/Hub baseline after recording this handoff. One synthetic V submission remains separately unauthorized until a new readiness decision.
required_hub_handoff.shared_runtime_rule: Hub owns the fixture, shared target process, Hub credentials and cleanup. Edge owns no shared-target launch action; the retained root and prior inputs remain untouched.

edge.required: Stable for at least five seconds with status ok/ready and records=0, bytes=0, corrupt=0, expired=0, pending_gap_notices=0, capacity_exhausted=false

hub.control_poll: A trusted mTLS/bearer empty control poll against the exact fresh fixture must return HTTP 200 with zero records and zero gaps
hub.failure_rule: No actor/helper invocation if any control-poll, ledger, pending, accumulator or frontier field is non-empty or unknown.

pre_submit_empty_state_gate.coordination: Hub and HA/coordination must acknowledge the same fresh contract and these receipts before the coordinator sends the explicit submit-once instruction.

single_submission_and_projection_rules.expected_projection: Exactly one VehicleName projection for the fresh bound synthetic name
single_submission_and_projection_rules.forbidden_projection: Any numeric telemetry, unit-bearing value, account credential, vehicle command or passive-vehicle claim
single_submission_and_projection_rules.sequence_classification: Classify every Hub sequence by its recorded disposition. Lifecycle sequences are reported separately; any unexplained sequence or numeric projection fails this handoff.
single_submission_and_projection_rules.r13_boundary: The historical r13 three-sequence caveat is not an acceptance expectation for this run and must not be used to justify unexplained output.

bounded_drain_and_cleanup.timeout_action: Record the exact boundary, stop only owned disposable processes in order and do not replay the producer record.

listener_ownership.shared_listener_rule: No wildcard bind, listener reuse or process replacement.

stop_order: Hub records its durable/timeout outcome and stops only its fresh fixture process
Edge stops the Edge core second
Verify 127.0.0.1:8080, 127.0.0.1:21443 and 127.0.0.1:21444 are closed, while any pre-existing shared listener remains untouched
bounded_drain_and_cleanup.required_stop_receipts: Record exact process IDs/UIDs, exit results, listener closure, retained state-root mode and no-secret/no-payload log scan for Edge, receiver and Hub.

edge_action_sequence: Read-only verify the exact macos13-arm64 target/address, fresh-root paths, listeners, process UIDs and private-input readability; abort if any binding is wildcard, occupied or ambiguous.

No Edge build or package install is authorized in this source-repair handoff. If a later source rebuild or package install is approved, acquire the shared heavy-build lock first, record the task and PID, and release it on exit.

For the separately authorized Hub empty-baseline phase, Hub may stage the recorded darwin-arm64 candidate without automatic start, use the direct canonical argv above, and configure only the fresh owner-only TLS, bearer and state inputs; Edge does not launch the shared target.
Hub runs Edge init and doctor, then starts the Edge core and receiver independently with the Edge helper; it verifies readyz before any producer submission.
Hub captures the stable Edge empty-state and trusted Hub empty control-poll receipts; no actor invocation is permitted until both are complete and the coordinator separately authorizes submit once.

Only after that separate authorization may the exact pinned ARM64 synthetic producer be invoked exactly once over receiver mTLS at the handoff endpoint; this proposal update itself does not authorize the event.

If the producer is later authorized, let the fresh Hub fixture pull, durably commit and acknowledge within the bounded drain window; classify every sequence, require exactly one VehicleName projection and verify Edge queue returns to zero without payload or credential values.
Apply the recorded cleanup order and stop receipts, verify 8080/21443/21444 are closed, retain the redacted evidence root and leave any pre-existing shared process untouched.

receiver mTLS ACK and Edge encrypted queue before and after Hub drain
Hub durable commit, per-sequence disposition, exactly one VehicleName projection and exact ACK/frontier receipt
separate Edge/receiver input custody and no secret/payload log exposure
bounded timeout/no-retry behavior and ordered process/listener cleanup with pre-existing shared processes preserved
